summary: Iteration 9 (Settings + Tab-Bar Auto-Hide, FRONTEND-ONLY) — full pass @ 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with REELS_MOCK=1. All 6 requested flows verified: (1) GEAR NAV — gear icon (testID=settings-button) is present in every main tab header (Create/Series/Library) and tapping it navigates to /settings with openai-key-input visible on all three. (2) BYOK — typing 'sk-test-123456789' into openai-key-input and tapping save-keys-button flipped the OpenAI status pill to 'Yours · sk-••••6789'. Tapping clear-openai raised the in-app Remove/Cancel confirm; tapping Remove returned the pill to 'Built-in credits'. Backend PATCH /api/settings roundtripped correctly. (3) STUDIO DEFAULTS PERSIST — tapping default-dur-15 and default-cap-mono, then navigating to Create tab and back into Settings, both chips remained highlighted (computed border=rgb(239,68,68) brand-red on 15/mono, default border on 30/signal). AsyncStorage persistence via /app/frontend/src/defaults.ts confirmed. (4) BRAND KIT — typed '@tester' into brand-handle-input, tapped save-brand-button → settings-toast rendered visible with text 'Brand saved ✓'. Tapping manage-outros-button opened the outro bottom sheet with both 'No outro' and 'Upload outro clip' rows visible. (5) TAB-BAR AUTO-HIDE — measured the reanimated wrapper transform on Library FlatList. Before scroll: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0). After wheel-scrolling down 6x on the reels-grid: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,140) → translateY=140px hides the bar off-screen. After wheel-scroll-up: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) → bar restored. Auto-hide works on web preview. (6) REGRESSION — Create/Series/Library nav intact; opening reel-card-7ee2e210 navigated to /reel/{id} and rendered 'Desert survival' with Download MP4 / Duplicate & edit / Edit narration / Create another reel controls. No red-screen. Only pre-existing warnings observed (expo-notifications web push token, props.pointerEvents deprecation).

critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx:158-208 BYOK flow is clean — masked key comes from backend (openai_key_masked), pill toggles on settings.openai_key_set. Clear flow uses Alert.alert with destructive confirm and PATCHes empty string, then updates local state. Solid.

settings.tsx:216-235 Studio defaults chips call persistDefaults() which optimistically updates local state and awaits saveDefaults() (AsyncStorage) — the useEffect on mount rehydrates from storage, so persistence across nav-back is guaranteed. Verified in DOM.

settings.tsx:252 save-brand-button calls api.updateSettings({brand_handle}) AND mirrors the value into defaults.watermark via saveDefaults() — sensible behaviour so a saved @handle auto-fills the Create screen watermark field.

(tabs)/_layout.tsx:9-14 TabBarVisibilityProvider correctly wraps the Tabs so the same shared value drives HidingTabBar AND the useHidingTabBar() hook consumed by index/series/library scroll views. Clean architecture.

tabbar.tsx:11-14 translate.value uses withTiming — 200ms hide / 180ms show. On web the reanimated transform is applied via matrix(1,0,0,1,0,140) which is exactly the expected hide translateY. Verified.
tabbar.tsx:20-27 useHidingTabBar computes dy from lastY and gates on |dy|>6, plus a hard show at y<=4 — this feels correct and avoids jitter for tiny scroll deltas.
index.tsx:66,284 and series.tsx:19,85 and library.tsx:24,90 all wire scrollHide.onScroll + scrollEventThrottle onto their scroll containers — no tab misses the hook. Verified.

settings-button testID is duplicated across the three tab headers because Expo Router keeps sibling tabs mounted. Not a bug (only one is visible at a time), but automated tests using CSS `[data-testid=settings-button]` need to pick the visible node. Consider unique per-tab testIDs (e.g. settings-button-library) in a future iteration for easier automation.
